policy: Reorientation and grid resampling do not constitute anatomical registration. Native, author-mapped, locally registered and unverified data remain distinct.

statusDefinitions.verified-native: Paired anatomy and labels verified against the target template.
statusDefinitions.published-template: Published FSL atlas placement accepted; no local registration estimate.
statusDefinitions.published-affine: An explicitly documented source affine mapping was already applied.
statusDefinitions.registered: A local template-to-template transform was estimated and audited.
statusDefinitions.unverified-template: Required source anatomy or mapping evidence unavailable; target overlay disabled.
statusDefinitions.legacy: Historical data retained without target alignment proof.

dk.operation: Paired FSL template FreeSurfer reconstruction; header-derived tkRAS->scannerRAS for surfaces; nearest-neighbour 2mm labels.
dk.limitations: Template segmentation, not individual or expert-certified anatomical boundaries.

aal.nativeSpace: MNI-family; precise template variant and paired image unverified
aal.operation: Header-based grid resampling only. No anatomical registration.
aal.missingEvidence: A verified source anatomical template paired with this distributed label image.
aal.limitations: Matching voxel axes, origin or grid do not establish matching anatomy. Retained as separate atlas data.

aal3.nativeSpace: AAL3v2 MNI-family; precise template variant and paired image unverified
aal3.operation: Header-based grid resampling only. No anatomical registration.
aal3.missingEvidence: A verified source anatomical template paired with this distributed label image.
aal3.limitations: The AAL3 source label set is preserved; its MNI designation alone does not prove alignment with FSL NLin6Asym.

ho.operation: Use original authors' published MNI mapping; RAS array reorientation only here.
ho.limitations: Published population atlas; individual morphology and label uncertainty remain.

jhu.operation: Use published FSL label image in its MNI grid; RAS reorientation only here.
jhu.limitations: Published cross-template mapping accepted from the distribution, not independently re-estimated. White-matter labels are not reconstructed fibers.

ba.operation: FSL-distributed Lancaster 2007 Talairach->MNI152 affine mapping, already applied in source. Not applied twice.
ba.limitations: Historical digitization and approximate affine mapping; not modern complete cytoarchitectonic boundaries.

ba-legacy.nativeSpace: Historical MRIcroN / BrainNet MNI-like BA; precise variant unverified
ba-legacy.operation: Retained historical data; no verified anatomical registration.
ba-legacy.limitations: Do not combine missing legacy numbers with FSL BA as one aligned atlas.

ba-histology.nativeSpace: FSL 5.0.1 Juelich MNI152 distribution; exact MNI variant unverified
ba-histology.operation: Use original authors' FSL-published mapping, 25% max-probability labels. No registration re-estimated here.
ba-histology.limitations: Overlay uses published FSL template placement. The old distribution's exact template variant has not been independently recovered; only explicit BA-named subset is included.

cerebellum.nativeSpace: Diedrichsen cerebellar atlas, FSL MNI FNIRT distribution
cerebellum.operation: Already normalized by source authors with FNIRT; no further estimated transform here.

hcp1065.operation: This project estimated 2mm MI affine + symmetric diffeomorphic CC template registration. Native streamlines must be transformed through the recorded point transform.
hcp1065.geometryApplication: See anatomy/manifest.json per-structure geometry and targetAlignment; native source JSON remains retained.
hcp1065.limitations: Population tractography and template registration estimate, not individual nerve accuracy. Original and registered paths must remain distinct.

pam50.operation: Native PAM50 anatomy only; no joint brain/spinal registration estimated.
pam50.limitations: Straightened cord should be shown as a separate atlas reference, not an anatomically continuous registered extension of the FSL brain.
